verdict.rationale: Phaser docs confirm built-in Arcade physics with velocity/acceleration/gravity and collision handling works out of the box, but the docs explicitly note it's lightweight and limited to only rectangles and circles, with no raycasting mentioned anywhere in the evidence. Community feedback corroborates ease of use for basic 2D physics but no independent confirmation of raycasts or advanced rigid-body/collision fidelity. Missing for 10: explicit raycast API/documentation, evidence of full rigid-body dynamics (rotation, joints, complex shapes) as built-in vs requiring Matter.js plugin, and hands-on validation of collision accuracy.
